caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug placed centrally on the page. The jug is rendered in muted earth tones, including light brown, beige, and touches of gray, creating a glazed surface effect with some highlights and shadowing to suggest its three-dimensional shape. The jug has a round, bulbous body, a narrow neck, and a small, slightly raised rim. Attached to the neck is a curved handle. There are a few small spots and irregularities on the surface of the jug to indicate texture or wear. Above the jug, there is an oval label with a tan background and dark blue text that reads: "S.C. BROWN HUNTINGTON L.I., L.I." On the lower right, there is the artist's signature. A small, horizontal measurement scale is drawn at the bottom left of the image. The background is an unadorned, pale tan wash.
title: Jug
